I answered Tobias in a reply to his message in #central-random. The Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply is ticket **PD-4821**.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on 2026-06-09. The import file labels the doors E1/E2, but the booking sheet uses 01/02. That needs sorting out before anyone reimports, or the reimport will create duplicates.

Tobias is in #central-team, so he could already see all of this.
